ti.title: ዑራኤል ሊቀ መላእክት
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ዑራኤል ንእዝራ ሱቱኤል
ጽዋእ ዘስተኻ
ስዩመ እግዚአብሔር
ንስኻ እኳ ኢኻ
[[/chorus]]

ዑራኤል ሊቀ መላእክት (2)
ክብርኻ ብዙሕ’ዩ እስከ ክዛረብ

ዑራኤል ንቅድስት ድንግል
ምስቲ ፍቁር ወዳ
በረኻ በረኻ
መሪሕካ ንስኻ

ዑራኤል መብረቕ ነጎድጓድ
ንኽግዝኡልካ
ካብ ኵሎም መላእክት
ንዓኻ ሃበካ

ti_ro.title: 'Urael liqe mela'kt
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
Urael liqe melakt (2)
[[/chorus]]

Kbrkha bzuh’yu ske kzareb
Urael nzra sutuel
Tswa zestekha
Syume gziabher
Nskha kwa ikha
Urael nqdst dngl
Msti fqur weda
Berekha berekha
Merihka nskha
Urael kab alaf melakt
Tbelts nskha
Bkbrkha fluy
Nay neged azazay
Urael mebreq negodgwad
Nkhgzulka
Kab kwilom melakt
Nakha habeka
Urael mun agelgalay
Wetehader nay semay
Tleakh nsahl
Kab amlakhna lul
